thesis: 가장 강한 숏 논리는 '디지털은행 수요가 없다'가 아니라 신용과 자본의 질이다. NU는 33% ROE와 12.4% risk-adjusted NIM을 기록하지만 90+ NPL은 6.9%로 상승했고, 빠른 대출성장은 규제자본을 소모한다. Brazil 집중과 74.3% founder voting control도 tail risk다. 현실적 60~70% 주가하락은 대손 급증·ROE 하락·Mexico 자본흡수와 멀티플 압축의 조합으로 설명 가능하다. 그러나 cutoff 현재 7개 RT 소유 Hard Veto의 필수 구성요건은 충족되지 않는다.

evidence.claim: Q2 90+ NPL increased to 6.9% while the credit portfolio reached $39.4B; the company explicitly expanded into higher-risk, higher-return segments.
Brazil CET1 fell from 13.0% at 2025 year-end to 11.9% at Q2 2026 and CAR from 16.6% to 15.7% as RWA expanded, though the subsidiary retained $1.848B excess capital margin.
The FY2025 20-F states David Vélez controlled 74.3% of combined voting power through the dual-class structure, allowing effective control of major corporate decisions.

Against the short thesis, the FY2025 20-F states management concluded internal control over financial reporting was effective at year-end, and no current restatement/material-weakness evidence was identified for Nu.
Q2 net income reached $1.061B, ROE 33%, risk-adjusted NIM 12.4%, activity 83.5% and ARPAC $17.1; these contradict a present moat or customer-value collapse.
Frozen harness values are $4.76 Bear, $18.56 Base and $34.85 Bull against $14.03 price. A severe credit/capital normalization can therefore support large equity downside even without insolvency.

counterevidence: Strong Q2 ROE, risk-adjusted NIM and per-share earnings growth directly contradict a current structural return collapse.
Brazil, Mexico and Colombia remain above local capital minima with meaningful buffers.
High activity, rising ARPAC and primary-bank credit performance contradict subsidy-only customer acquisition.
The frozen price is below Base and far below Bull, so current valuation does not require an impossible outcome.
unknowns: Full-cycle vintage loss curves for the newer higher-risk cohorts.
Normalized Mexico/Colombia ROE after banking scale and promotional deposit pricing.
Quantified economic impact if founder-controlled capital allocation diverges from minority preferences.
falsifiers: 90+ NPL stabilizes/declines while ROE stays high-20s+ and capital buffers remain comfortable, weakening the core short thesis.
Mexico/Colombia demonstrate durable returns above cost of equity without heavy subsidy or equity injections.
PBR share, deposits and ARPAC continue rising while cost-to-serve stays near current levels, weakening moat-compression claims.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: FY2025 20-F states ICFR was effective and no cutoff-valid restatement, material weakness, auditor dispute or accounting-integrity event was identified. Founder control is a governance risk but not evidence of dishonesty.

Nu is profitable, primarily retail-deposit funded, and each core regulated subsidiary remains above minimum capital ratios. Banking deposits are operating funding, not evidence that ordinary operations require recurrent external equity.

83.5% activity, rising ARPAC, very low service cost and stronger credit performance among primary-bank customers show recurring customer value. Promotional deposit pricing is a monitor, not proof of value-free growth.

Reported ROE 33%, risk-adjusted NIM 12.4% and sharply higher per-share net income contradict a current structural return collapse. The RF incremental-return proxy is noisy but not needed alone to clear this veto.
Customer count, activity, ARPAC, deposits and primary-bank depth are expanding. Digital product copyability is a future threat, but there is no present persistent moat contraction.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Frozen price $14.03 is below Base $18.56 and far below Bull $34.85. The veto's price-above-Bull condition is false.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Nu spans cards, deposits, loans, investments, SMEs and premium banking across three countries. Brazil concentration and banking regulation are material, but no single customer/product/regulatory event is shown to cause irrecoverable franchise failure.
